scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const group of ['apps', 'packages']) for (const workspace of fs.readdirSync(group)) fs.rmSync(`${group}/${workspace}/dist`, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @krazitv/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @krazitv/process && npm run typecheck --workspace @krazitv/media && npm run typecheck --workspace @krazitv/signal && npm run typecheck --workspace @krazitv/plex-spike && npm run typecheck --workspace @krazitv/web
